ctx.x: No, I mean, in 32 or so.

Oh, he broke up with P. the book out there. Yeah. He just quit the band. See, he quit the band with P. the book out there. Then he made up this band. See, he consists of me, Eddie Pearson, Leo Desjard, Joe Phillips, Arthur Durbney, Elliot Taylor, Manuel Sayles, and Simon Moreira. And a singer by the name of Harold Wells. That was his band. And we played together from 32 until 35. I did.
And I left the band in 35.

ctx.x: We'll put it on the next tape. You got time for one another half hour, huh? Yeah. Then I'll take you to the other building and run on down then. Oh, back to Piran. Who played piano with him when you were with him?

Well, when I was with him, he had a new band. See, he had got rid of Pete and all of that bunch. See, he had me, Eddie Pearson, Joe Phillips, Leo Dejon, Elliot Taylor, and Arthur Dudley, and Alavretta, Alexandra of piano. Oh, yeah. Sales, and Simon. See, that was his new band, you see.
